nodes.label: Revision monotonic events with resume token and bounded history
nodes.rationale: Immediate-exit on disconnect loses readiness and host; unconditional apply corrupts state via gaps and duplicates; snapshot-only cannot efficiently restore; client-time-only allows spoofing; unbounded history exhausts SQLite. Hence apply-next-only with dedupe, resync on gap, bounded history with snapshot fallback, grace period, and bound resume token.
